# HIIT by Down Dog

> > Personalized HIIT (High Intensity Interval Training) workout app from Down Dog, offering customizable bodyweight and strength training exercises for iOS and Android.

Part of the Down Dog fitness app family by Yoga Buddhi Co., which also includes Yoga, Prenatal Yoga, Barre, and Meditation apps. The HIIT app provides dynamically generated interval training workouts tailored to user preferences and fitness levels.

## Key Topics

- HIIT (High Intensity Interval Training)
- Down Dog
- Personalized workouts
- Interval training

- Strength training
